records.text: The Jerusalem Post reported that World Jewish Congress president Ronald Lauder was involved in Donald Trump's push concerning Greenland.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Jerusalem Post, the world Jewish Congress president Ronald Lauder is involved in Trump's push for Greenland.

verification.notes: The Jerusalem Post published a report stating that World Jewish Congress president Ronald Lauder was involved in Donald Trump's renewed push concerning Greenland. The statement accurately describes that publication.

sources.title: World Jewish Congress President Ronald Lauder involved in Trump's push for Greenland — The Jerusalem Post
sources.relevance: The cited publication directly makes the report described in the statement.

records.text: Greenland has an estimated 31 billion barrels of untapped crude oil, which may be part of why Trump wants to acquire it.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And my best guess is that's at least part of the reason, the real reason why Trump is obsessed with acquiring Greenland, because they do have untapped crude oil, an estimated 31 billion barrels worth.

verification.notes: Context reviewed at 39:11. A roughly 31-billion-barrel figure exists for undiscovered Northeast Greenland hydrocarbons/oil-equivalent, not simply proven untapped crude oil. Resources may contribute to strategic interest, but Trump publicly emphasized national security and denied minerals were the main reason.

sources.title: Oil and Gas Exploration in Greenland - Government of Greenland
sources.relevance: Official report supports an approximately 31-billion-barrel oil-equivalent estimate for undiscovered northeast Greenland resources, not 31 billion barrels of proven crude.

sources.title: Trump's Greenland Push: Security and Economic Motives - TIME
sources.relevance: Documents stated security and economic motives; it does not establish oil as the single true motive.
